raw_definitions: Definisi : fight like a ~, berlawan (ber)mati-matian; the ~’s share, bahagian terbesar: the ~’s share of his salary goes on food and lodging, bahagian terbesar drpd gajinya adalah utk makanan dan penginapan. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. carnivorous mammal of cat family, singa: the ~ roared in pain, singa itu mengaum kesakitan; 2. brave, famous personality, celebrity, (orang yg) /termasyhur, ternama/: a literary ~, penulis yg termashyur; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
